REVIEW CARD 5-000000001
Subject: Foreign Languages Linguistics
Topic: listening comprehension
Core concept: Communicative competence includes grammatical, sociolinguistic, and pragmatic knowledge.
Study task: Explain the concept of listening comprehension in your own words. Identify its key terms, describe one real-world example, and explain how it connects to reading comprehension.
Reasoning task: Compare two examples related to listening comprehension. State the similarities, differences, assumptions, and limits of the comparison. Support each conclusion with a clear reason.
